<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/cases/{caseId}/classify/{jobId}/results"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Review requirement is computed from the stored flags and the job routing rule, or from the routing override, so rules can change without a rerun. A running job returns the rows written so far with complete=false. Filtered scans cover at most 50,000 rows per request; follow the continuation to go on.
